title: Qi'ra
description: Growing up as a scrumrat on Corellia, working for Lady Proxima, Qi'ra found herself sold off to Crimson Dawn after her failed bid to escape with Han Solo. Working her way up, she became Dryden Vos's most trusted top lieutenant in that shady criminal organization. Cunning and charming in equal measure, when she saw a way to take control of the criminal syndicate for herself, she took it.
